title: SOAR Export 8.8.0 catalog and tested matrices have different scopes
problem: Help describes a November 4 maintenance release, Python 3.13 only and the tested row CIM 8.5.0-1681, Enterprise 10.4.2 or 10.2.2, Cloud Platform 10.5.2605 or 10.4.2604, optional ES 8.8.0 or 8.7.0, and SOAR Cloud or On-premises 8.8.0 or 8.7.0. The current Splunkbase catalog shows a November 3 listing and broader 10.2–10.7 Platform lines, and explicitly distinguishes its upgrade listings from tested combinations. Neither an unlisted combination nor a particular customer rollout is established.

audiences: Readers evaluating documented release or feature scope
exclusions: No unlisted exact pairing, rollout, entitlement or customer authorization established.

scopeComparison: The versioned prerequisite tables identify functionality-tested exact combinations. Splunkbase explicitly describes a broader upgrade-listing scope.

impact.customerScenario: Selecting a supported integration tuple for the 8.8.0 Export app.
impact.consequence: A catalog version line can be mistaken for evidence of a tested exact pairing.
